## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (hand-checkable values / reference checks for numerical changes)
- [ ] `ruff check`, `mypy`, `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated (methodology for statistical changes; CHANGELOG for schema changes)
- [ ] No private data in tests, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] No new verdict language in findings; unavailable values use status + reason
